summary.answer: Constructs CoD.GameUpdateNotification from the displayed menu/controller/layout arguments. Creates Backing as LUI.UIImage.new, NotificationText as LUI.UIText.new. Connects 2 model/path references; the model subscription effects below specify which receiver changes and under which nil/value guard. Installs 2 event/action/override bindings; each callback keeps its captured controller/menu/widget references and executes only on its bound delivery. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.

summary.answer: Creates Hud_MP_Codcaster menu, safe-area child and MP HUD components, current-weapon damage model binding, score notifications and spectator/profile state consumers. On score_event it prioritizes bounty score, then combat-efficiency score when spawn selection is inactive, then normal score. Objective ShowNotification predicates are AlwaysFalse here. HideAllButScoreboard is killcam/final/round/stage visibility union; SpeedBoost uses exact gadget id/state; HideForCodCaster requires spectator profile. X input is blocked only while AreXButtonPressesDisallowed; player_spawned outside draft disallows X400ms. Menu_loaded sizes PC to HUD area and console to safe area, dispatches to children when unhandled; then focus/state restoration, close registration, postload, back-button preservation, grenade warnings and cursor disable occur in literal order. Menu selection into this MP codcaster path remains conditional; no universal HMH requirement is inferred.
unknowns: Per-body nil/error/return/lifetime limits are explicit in ordered operations; no universal cleanup, cancellation or exception recovery is inferred.
